headline: Bridge Work Snarls Evening Commute
text:
Bridge Work Snarls Evening Commute

The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning. The report recommends three changes: shorter meetings, clearer agendas and more time for public comment. A spokesperson for the department declined to comment on the specifics, saying only that a full report would be released soon. Teachers and parents have raised concerns about class sizes, and the district says it is reviewing staffing levels. A small group of volunteers spent the morning clearing debris from the trail after the storm. Residents packed the meeting room, many carrying signs and asking for more detail about how the money would be spent. For now, the practical effect is modest: a handful of new signs, a revised schedule and a promise to revisit the issue in the fall. Construction crews closed two lanes of the bridge for most of the afternoon, causing delays across the city.
